item.description: - Improved Kontakt library discovery on macOS and Windows while filtering unrelated Service Center product records. - Added batch repair with deterministic folder matching and a preview for matched, unmatched, and ambiguous libraries. - Added transactional batch additions, repairs, and removals that request administrator authorization only once. - Prevented malformed or duplicate classic-order data from blocking successful library removal, with a warning when the order still needs attention. - Refined the library toolbar so Repair appears only for selected libraries that need attention and action controls remain compact across languages. - Hidden PowerShell windows during Windows inventory and mutation tasks while preserving the required UAC confirmation. - Fixed single-library removal on Windows from both the toolbar and the library actions menu. - Updated application, installer, updater, and About branding to use cloin.se.
